what: A full-screen photo panel shrinks into the spot taken by another element (the blank gap between words of a big heading), becoming a framed picture with 18px rounded corners. The clip-path inset tightens to the target box over 1.3s cubic-bezier(.645,.045,.355,1), and the photo inside scales to .8 over the same length so it still fills the frame with room to spare. Re-measures when the target moves or the window resizes

options.target: Selector for the required target element — shrinks to that box’s position
options.delay: Wait before stems grow after opening (sec), default 0
options.dur · radius · scale: Shrink duration (s) · frame corner radius (px) · inner photo scale, default 1.3 · 18 · .8
options.start: With wait, it shrinks when fx:play is sent to the element
options.fx:shrunk: Event bubbling up from the element when fully shrunk

from.where: index.html .cz-loader__bg (original #loader .background-w.animate — clip-path inset(var(--inset) round 18px) 1.3s cubic-bezier(.645,.045,.355,1), photo scale3d(.8,.8,1), attached at 1.8s of the loader timeline)
